description: Use this when you want to read one bounty in full before you enter it: what to build, how the winner is picked and the reward each place gets. One competition (a bounty): its description, rules, resolution (how the winner is decided), prizes, phases (dev and final, whether each phase's scores show yet and placementsHeld, whether the competition holds its placements now), placements (after_finalize, the default: every phase's scores, ranks and prize places stay hidden from everyone but admins, the entry's owner included, until its ranking phase is finalized, and the entries stay listed; live: each phase's scores follow its own setting), the validated competition bundle, where its kit and leaderboard are (leaderboard.rankKey: the column entries rank by; leaderboard.tieBreak, only when the bundle names one: the column an exact tie on the rank key goes to, its key, title and whether the higher or lower value wins, before the earlier receipt), its baseline (what its entries are measured against: holding cash, 0 SOL, on a pump replay, unless its bundle sets prize_requires_beating_baseline; else, that pump replay included, the best ranked house baseline's score, which a placement must beat under prize_requires_beating_baseline; null before a baseline is graded), its demand (who wants the artifact) and its reproduce command (how to grade a bot on its kit as the server does; null when it is graded on the server only), and every listed entry with its rank-key score. Beside them, rulesNote, startingBalance and notices. rulesNote: null unless the rules' Transcript gate section no longer quotes the transcript checks in force, then a dated note saying so (text), the current text of each check that differs (current, each `<check id>: <sentence>`) and where every current check is read (href, the requirements: get_requirements). startingBalance: what every bot starts with on a replay trading harness (pumpfun-replay/v2, bars-replay/v1, clmm-replay/v1), the capital its bundle fixes for every entrant, as an exact amount in a unit (10 SOL, 10000 USDC); null for any other harness kind and for a competition with no validated bundle. notices: what GET /api/competitions/:slug/notices answers, oldest first, an empty list for most competitions. Each notice is one step of a bars final window's replacement under its gap rule (step rejected: the final window was rejected for gaps and the replacement window is graded in its place; attached: the replacement window is recorded and every final entry runs on it; refunding: the replacement was rejected too, so no prize is paid and no result is posted), with when it was posted, its title and words, and the final and replacement windows. The competition page shows the newest above the scores. sealedWindow, on a competition whose final phase is scored on a sealed window (null otherwise): the pool (windows, hours), the drand round that draws the scored window (beaconRound, beaconAt), the sidecar's sha256, the draw once made, and commitment, the final phase's deadline commitment once made (its sha256, committedAt, entriesRoot and entries, failKey and anchor; null before; anchor: the Solana transaction whose memo carries the sha256, once finalized there, with its cluster, signature, blockTime and anchor.explorer, that transaction's Solana Explorer link, null on localnet, which no public explorer reads; anchor null until then): get_deadline_commitment reads the document, its leaves and their proofs. judgeRounds, only on a judged program/v1 competition (absent otherwise): how its judge ranks the entries, as anchors (how many house reference entries each entry plays in the dev phase), swissRounds (the final heat's Swiss rounds), finalists (the places its playoff takes) and media (text or image, what the judge compares).
